title: [3.3.1.0] AAPS app Status light / Threshold warning pump battery level (yellow) does not work
body:
AAPS app Status light / Threshold warning pump battery level (yellow) does not work.
It stays white all the time.

Noticed at least in AAPS 3.3.1.0 build but may it is already in 3.3.0.0

comments.body: paste your settings from preferences and screenshot of overview

Screenshots are from test system (virtual pump, todays latest dev build) where pump battery level is continuously 50%.
Originally the problem was noticed with real pump when A-C Insight battery level lowered into 95% where I has the yellow warning.
